tools.name: get_dating_app_photo_rules
tools.description: Official photo rules for a dating app (Tinder, Hinge or Bumble): how many photos, how verification works, what is not allowed, and its AI-photo policy, with links to the official sources. Use when someone asks what photos a dating app allows or requires.

tools.name: check_ai_photo_policy
tools.description: Whether Tinder, Hinge and Bumble allow AI-generated or AI-edited profile photos, how they detect them, what happens if you break the rules, and how to use AI photos safely — quoted from each app's official guidelines. Omit app to compare all three.

tools.name: audit_dating_photo
tools.description: Score one dating-profile photo 0-100 and list concrete issues and fixes (lighting, framing, face visibility, background, realism). Takes a public https URL to a JPEG/PNG/WebP image. Free: 5 audits per day per user. The photo is analysed and not stored.
